_comment: Desired state for branch protection on the default branch. This file is CANONICAL:
the live GitHub configuration is compared against it by tools/checks/branch-protection.sh
(RULE-GOV-001), so a protection silently disabled in the web UI is detectable.
Scope note (decision F4 in docs/plan/phase-0-2.md): a pull request is NOT required, so
direct pushes to main stay allowed. required_status_checks was verified empirically on a
throwaway branch on 2026-08-04 to gate pull-request merges WITHOUT rejecting direct
pushes, so both halves of that decision hold at once.
Defence in depth, not a single control:
- required_status_checks stops a red pull request being merged;
- deploy.yml runs the same verify job before build-and-push and deploy, so a direct
push that fails verification builds and ships nothing;
- non_fast_forward and deletion protect the branch history itself.
Required-reviewer enforcement is impossible with a single maintainer and is recorded as
RISK-GOV-001 in rules/ledger.yaml, with a re-open trigger.
name: main-protection
